is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus s.l. and Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 2, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for L1014F-kdr and L1014S-kdr (page 10, lines 321-322).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper provides genotype counts for L1014S-kdr in An. gambiae s.s. (98%; 90/92) and states no L1014S-kdr or L1014F-kdr were detected in An. arabiensis (n=230) (page 10, lines 323-325).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Misungwi district, Tanzania, using field-collected mosquitoes (page 4, lines 112-114).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data (page 4, lines 103-106).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Misungwi district, Tanzania, across 86 clusters (page 4, lines 104-105).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between August and December 2018 (page 4, line 114).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific entomological survey conducted in 2018 in Misungwi district.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in the main text (page 10).

assessment.summary: This study investigated vector population bionomics, insecticide resistance, and malaria transmission in Misungwi district, Tanzania, in 2018. It reports high resistance to pyrethroids and provides genotype data for L1014F-kdr and L1014S-kdr in An. gambiae s.l. populations.
